tasks.title: Conversation #117
tasks.transcript:
Man: I'm so excited for our trip to Italy next month. Have you decided which cities you want to visit?
Woman: Yes, definitely. Roman, Florence. I'd love to see the historic sites and museums.
Man: Good choices. I've heard the food in Florence is amazing. We should try some local restaurants.
Woman: Absolutely. I'll let you choose the places.
